records.name: Otręby owsiane

sources.identity_evidence: The page names Sante oat bran, lists barcode 5900617010919 and a 200 g pack, and provides nutrition per 100 g.
sources.notes: A second exact-barcode retailer page reports a conflicting panel: 52 g carbs, 18 g fiber, 7.3 g fat, 16 g protein, 374 kcal per 100 g. This source's values are retained as the candidate pending label verification.

conflicts: Exact-barcode sources disagree on all core nutrition values: Torimpex reports 44/19/8.7/18/364, while Dallas reports 52/18/7.3/16/374 (carbs/fiber/fat/protein/kcal per 100 g).
records.notes: Candidate is identity and basis verified, but macro conflict requires label review before catalog acceptance.

records.name: Sól himalajska różowa

sources.identity_evidence: Exact barcode 5900617013224, Sante pink Himalayan salt, 350 g; the page provides a nutrition panel per 100 g.
sources.notes: Panel explicitly reports zero values for all requested nutrients.

conflicts: Another exact-barcode retailer lists iodine 2313 µg/100 g whereas this page reports 3026 µg/100 g; requested macro fields agree at zero.
records.notes: Hold: nutrition for salt is all zeros and existing OFF policy does not establish whether such a record is useful; exact identity and basis are supported.

records.name: Ciasteczka zbożowe musli z owocami

sources.identity_evidence: The page identifies Sante muesli fruit breakfast cookies, barcode 5900617031723 and 300 g, and provides nutrition per 100 g.
sources.notes: Product is marked discontinued by the retailer; values are per 100 g.

records.notes: Exact barcode also appears in Sante product catalog for its muesli fruit breakfast cookies.
root_review: Removed fiber value not supported by the retrieved source text.

records.name: Sucharki

sources.identity_evidence: Auchan product feed identifies Sonko rusks with EAN 5902180130506 and provides nutrition per 100 g.
sources.notes: Another exact-barcode retailer's panel differs, reporting 68 g carbs, 4.3 g fiber, 7 g fat, 11 g protein, 388 kcal.

conflicts: Exact-barcode sources show different nutrition panels; likely formulation/label differences. The Auchan feed is selected as candidate pending label verification.
records.notes: Exact identity and per-100-g basis are supported; conflicting values require package review.

records.name: Mini sucharki pełnoziarniste

sources.identity_evidence: Exact EAN 5902180390504, Sonko mini wholegrain rusks, 120 g pack; nutrition table explicitly states per 100 g.

conflicts: Other exact-barcode retailer pages provide 1666 kJ / 395 kcal, fat 9 g, carbs 63 g, fiber 7.2 g, protein 12 g per 100 g. The selected panel is the one with directly itemized kcal and complete core macros.
records.notes: Hold recommended for package verification because another exact-barcode source reports a materially different panel.

records.name: Pasta roślinna o smaku wołowiny
records.notes: Exact-code searches did not produce a source establishing this product identity and a nutrition panel. Similar Sonko spreads were excluded.

records.name: Płatki jęczmienne błyskawiczne

sources.identity_evidence: The page identifies Kupiec instant barley flakes, exact barcode 5902172000282, 400 g package, and a nutrition panel per 100 g.

conflicts: Carrefour Frisco's exact-barcode page reports salt 2.0 g/100 g while Torimpex and other exact-barcode sources report 1.6 g; requested macros match.
